title: This issue affects NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source configurations that use HTTP/2. (CVE-2026-123007)
description: CVE-2026-123007 is a vulnerability in NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source configurations using HTTP/2. It involves a heap buffer overflow caused by the flow control window exceeding allowed thresholds when processing certain traffic. This can lead to worker process crashes or memory corruption. Under specific conditions, such as when ASLR is disabled or bypassed, remote code execution is possible. This issue affects the data plane only and does not expose the control plane. No affected versions or patch information are provided.
